title: Shipping and delivery times
content: Standard delivery takes 3 to 5 business days after dispatch. Express delivery takes 1 to 2 business days. Orders placed after 5 PM local time are processed on the next business day. Delivery estimates do not include customs delays.

title: Track an order
content: Open My Orders, select the order, and choose Track package to see the latest carrier event. Tracking can take up to 24 hours after dispatch to appear. If a tracking event has not changed for 5 business days, contact support with the order number.

title: Change a delivery address
content: A delivery address can be changed only while an order is marked Processing. Go to My Orders, select the order, and choose Edit delivery address. Once an order is dispatched, support cannot redirect it; contact the carrier once tracking is available.

title: Cancel an order
content: You can cancel an order from My Orders while it is Processing. Select the order and choose Cancel order. Dispatched orders cannot be cancelled, but eligible items can be returned after delivery. A cancellation confirmation is sent by email.

title: Missing or incorrect item
content: If an item is missing or incorrect, report it within 14 days of delivery through My Orders > Report a problem. Include photos of the package label and delivered items where possible. Support will arrange a replacement, refund, or return based on stock and eligibility.

title: Returns eligibility
content: Most unused items in original condition can be returned within 30 days of delivery. Personalized, final-sale, and hygiene-sensitive items are not eligible once opened. The order detail page shows whether an item is eligible for return.

title: Start a return
content: Go to My Orders, select the delivered order, and choose Return items. Select a reason, print or download the return label, and drop the package at the selected carrier. Keep the carrier receipt until the refund is complete.

title: Refund processing times
content: After a return is received and accepted, refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5 to 10 business days. Your bank or card provider may require additional time to display the credit. Shipping fees are refunded only when the item was incorrect, damaged, or defective.

title: Find invoices and receipts
content: Subscription invoices and payment receipts are available in Account > Billing > Invoices. Select an invoice to download a PDF. Invoices show the billing name, billing address, tax amount, payment status, and invoice number.

title: Update a payment method
content: Open Account > Billing > Payment methods and select Add payment method or Edit. Set one saved method as default before removing the existing default. For security, support cannot view complete card numbers or manually update a card for you.

title: Failed subscription renewal
content: When a renewal payment fails, we notify the account owner and retry the charge automatically within 48 hours. Update the payment method before the retry. Access continues during the 7-day grace period; after that, the subscription is paused until payment succeeds.

title: Duplicate or unrecognized charge
content: First compare the charge date, amount, and merchant descriptor with invoices in Account > Billing. A temporary card authorization may appear as a pending charge and usually disappears within 7 business days. For a confirmed duplicate or unfamiliar settled charge, contact support promptly; do not post card details in chat.

title: Reset a password
content: On the sign-in screen select Forgot password, enter the account email, and use the reset link sent to your inbox. Reset links expire after 30 minutes. Check spam or request another link if the message is not received within 10 minutes.

title: Secure a compromised account
content: If you do not recognize a login, change your password immediately and enable two-factor authentication in Account > Security. Review active sessions and sign out unfamiliar devices. Support never asks for your password, authentication code, or full card number.

title: Change an account email address
content: Open Account > Profile and choose Change email. Enter the new address and confirm the verification links sent to both the old and new addresses. If you cannot access the old email, contact support and be prepared to complete account ownership verification.

title: Fix app loading or sign-in issues
content: Update the app to the current version, sign out and sign back in, then clear the app cache. On the web, try a private browser window and disable browser extensions. If the issue continues, include your device model, operating system, app version, error message, and a screenshot in your support request.

title: Service outage and status updates
content: Check the public status page for active incidents and planned maintenance. During a confirmed outage, support cannot provide an individual workaround or restoration time beyond the published incident update. Do not repeatedly retry a payment or order action during an outage.

title: Supported browsers and devices
content: Use the latest two versions of Chrome, Firefox, Safari, or Edge for the web experience. Enable JavaScript and cookies. The mobile app supports the two latest major releases of iOS and Android. Rooted, jailbroken, or unsupported devices may not be able to sign in.

title: Privacy and personal-data requests
content: To request a copy, correction, or deletion of personal data, open Account > Privacy and submit the appropriate request. We verify account ownership before processing. Deletion may retain limited data needed for legal, fraud-prevention, or financial-record obligations.

title: When an issue is escalated
content: Support escalates issues that need account investigation, policy exceptions, payment disputes, security review, accessibility help, or engineering analysis. You receive a ticket ID and updates by email. High-priority security and suspected fraud reports are reviewed ahead of standard requests.
